what: --require-result-pattern requires a ### FINDING_[0-9] line but valid empty-merge output is attestation-only
scenario_or_breakage: When every waterfall phase returns only narrative plus LARCH_AGGREGATOR_EMPTY_MERGE_ATTESTED (orchestrator contract for duplicate-only merges), grep -Eq never matches, DISPATCH_OK=false, aggregate-findings emits REASON=dispatch-failed and review-core continues voting instead of REASON=validation-exhausted exit 2
suggested_fix: Extend the ERE to accept structured findings OR a full-line attestation (e.g. alternation with ^[[:space:]]*LARCH_AGGREGATOR_EMPTY_MERGE_ATTESTED[[:space:]]*$); document the dual gate in aggregate-findings.md
